description: The ambient environment variable names a seat may start with; every other name of its controller's environment stays behind. Read by workerBaseEnv (src/runner/dispatch/adapters.mjs); a launcher that builds a seat's environment elsewhere reads this same file. FGOS_STATE_ROOT is pinned by workerBaseEnv itself, not listed. A provider variable reaches a seat through the executor's declared env or its credential store, never the ambient environment.
